metadata.description: Must remain false unless the repository owner approves the exact DEV plan and immutable image digest.
Deploy a new Entra-only PostgreSQL Flexible Server in the delegated subnet. Leave false when PostgreSQL is managed separately.
Must be a free, non-overlapping range in the existing VNet. Workload profiles require /27 or larger.
Name of an existing Key Vault from which DEV secrets (such as database credentials) are resolved.
Object ID of the existing DEV migration identity; its PostgreSQL administrator mapping is removed after migration succeeds.
Choose only after dated region availability and cost review. Required when provisionPostgres is true.
Create a new Azure Managed Redis instance and private endpoint. Leave false until SKU and cost are approved.
Azure Managed Redis SKU; verify regional availability and current cost before opting in.
Opt in to the Azure Event Hubs -> PostgreSQL outbox -> Redis/SignalR candidate simulation path.

resources.name: [parameters('appName')]

configuration.secrets: [if(not(empty(parameters('keyVaultName'))), createArray(createObject('name', 'postgres-connection-string', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/postgres-connection-string', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), '2023-07-01').vaultUri), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-runtime', parameters('appName')))), createObject('name', 'foundry-api-key', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/foundry-api-key', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), '2023-07-01').vaultUri), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-runtime', parameters('appName'))))), createArray())]

env.name: Redis__Endpoint
env.value: [if(parameters('enableCandidateFeed'), format('{0}:{1}', if(parameters('provisionRedis'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise', parameters('redisName')), '2025-07-01').hostName, reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise', parameters('redisName')), '2025-07-01').hostName), if(parameters('provisionRedis'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/databases', parameters('redisName'), 'default'), '2025-07-01').port, reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/databases', parameters('redisName'), 'default'), '2025-07-01').port)), '')]

dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/eventhubs', parameters('eventHubsNamespaceName'), parameters('candidateEventHubName')), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceId('Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/eventhubs', parameters('eventHubsNamespaceName'), parameters('candidateEventHubName')), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-runtime', parameters('appName'))), 'EventHubsDataSender'))]

resources.name: [format('{0}-eventworker', parameters('appName'))]
dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/eventhubs', parameters('eventHubsNamespaceName'), parameters('candidateEventHubName')), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceId('Microsoft.EventHub/namespaces/eventhubs', parameters('eventHubsNamespaceName'), parameters('candidateEventHubName')), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-eventworker', parameters('appName'))), 'EventHubsDataReceiver'))]

redisEndpoint.value: [if(parameters('deployPrivateDevTopology'), format('{0}:{1}', if(parameters('provisionRedis'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise', parameters('redisName')), '2025-07-01').hostName, reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise', parameters('redisName')), '2025-07-01').hostName), if(parameters('provisionRedis'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/databases', parameters('redisName'), 'default'), '2025-07-01').port, reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Cache/redisEnterprise/databases', parameters('redisName'), 'default'), '2025-07-01').port)), '')]
